from dataclasses import dataclass, field

class TaskStatus(Enum):
    """任务状态枚举"""
    PENDING = "pending"           # 待处理
    RUNNING = "running"           # 执行中
    PAUSED = "paused"             # 已暂停
    COMPLETED = "completed"       # 已完成
    FAILED = "failed"             # 失败
